description: The man wears a cream long tunic with a round dark-and-gold bordered collar, broad central woven decoration and gold-trimmed cuffs and hem. Plum-purple outer panels frame the front, while a matching large gold-bordered purple drape lies over his left shoulder and arm, hanging low with a fringed patterned end. Two round purple-stone gold brooches decorate the shoulder area. A dark leather belt has a large decorated round gold buckle and a long strap with small gold fittings and a tasselled tip. Tall dark brown leather boots and a purple-stone ring are visible. Head and hands remain uncovered.
